about: The remake's 100 Gold Skulltulas (Enemy_Skulltula_Gold, by Hash and map folder) mapped to SoH's GS checks, one to one (research 2026-11-15 from the maps' positions, room indices, flags and the chests already mapped; scratchpad agents' reports, checked one-to-one). confidence: high (room/place and a distinctive feature agree), medium, low (by elimination). closed: logic does not count on it (junk only, as remake chests of unknown access), why given. region/rule: replace SoH's where the remake differs. rule_note: remake differences where SoH's rule is stricter (kept) or to see in game. Used with settings shuffle_tokens.
